pages.title: Marble and panels
pages.text: Shape Marble into smooth blocks, bricks, pillars and slabs. Dye it to suit your base.$(br2)BlackTech and MarbleTech panels add patterns, animations and glowing details. Many use ordinary crafting.$(br2)Try dark marble with blue accents around your machines.

pages.title: Finishing touches
pages.text: $(li)Slopes and ramps soften edges.$(li)Glass and tech fences divide workspaces.$(li)Reinforced Marble protects important structures.$(li)Flux Glow and Flat Lights illuminate rooms.$(li)Facades hide cables.$(br2)Glowing artwork on a panel does not necessarily light the room. Place actual lights where mobs could spawn.
